description: Every Auvik endpoint as a command, plus the cross-client answers the Auvik UI and API cannot give you.

novel_features.name: Fleet end-of-life & warranty rollup
novel_features.description: See every device approaching or past end-of-support across all your clients at once, bucketed by urgency.

novel_features.name: Device change forensics timeline
novel_features.description: Merge config revisions, audit entries, notes, and alerts for one device into a single chronological story.

novel_features.name: Configuration backup audit
novel_features.description: Find devices with no configuration backup, a stale backup, or no running-config backup, across every client.

novel_features.name: Fleet inventory diff between syncs
novel_features.description: List devices added, removed, or changed fleet-wide since the last sync, attributed to each client.

novel_features.name: Billable-count reconciliation
novel_features.description: Put each client's billable usage count next to the actual synced inventory and show the device rows behind the difference.

novel_features.name: Discovery blind spots
novel_features.description: List every device Auvik cannot fully poll, per client, with the credential state behind each gap.

novel_features.name: Alert noise ranking
novel_features.description: Rank devices and clients by alert volume over a window, with device names, types, clients and severity mix resolved.

novel_features.name: SaaS license waste rollup
novel_features.description: Surface SaaS apps with active users but no license record, and licenses nobody is using, per client.

novel_features.name: Client network health scorecard
novel_features.description: Per-client health rollup: end-of-support exposure, backup gaps, blind spots and alerts.
